title: Efficient Model-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning with Variational State Tabulation

Q1.quote: We evaluated the VaST agent on a series of navigation tasks implemented in the VizDoom environment

Q2.quote: We used the structure of the DQN network in (Mnih et al., 2015) for both NEC and Prioritized D–DQN as well as the encoder of VaST

Q3.quote: 7.1.1 VaST We used a latent dimensionality of d = 32 unless otherwise stated. For training, we used a minibatch size of 128 and a learning rate of 2 × 1e−4.

Q4.quote: 7.1.2 NEC We used a latent embedding of size 64, ns = 50 for the n–step Q-value backups, and α = 0.1 ... 7.1.3 Prioritized D–DQN We used the rank–based version of Prioritized DQN with α = 0.7 and β = 0.5

Q5.quote: The full code for VaST can be found at https://github.com/danecor/VaST/.

Q6.quote: For the three network–based models, hyperparameters were chosen based on a coarse parameter search in two mazes (Figure 3 excluding the hazards and Figure 5 excluding the teleporter), using the previously published hyperparameters as a starting point for the baselines
